fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM103,775. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0055281/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM or equivalent with at least FIVE (5) Credits including THREE (3) from Bahasa Malaysia, English, and Mathematics, ONE (1) from a Science subject (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science, or Applied Science), and ONE (1) from any other subject; OR Pass GCE O-level or equivalent with FIVE (5) Cs including TWO (2) from English and Mathematics, ONE (1) from a Science subject (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science, or Applied Science), and TWO (2) from other subjects; OR Pass Certificate in Health Sciences with at least 2.75 CGPA.
